grounding: Actual governed model only for SQL construction; SQL frozen before physical database/API inspection. Host must separately bind the approved Demo SQLite source; no DSN inferred from source_key.

questions.question: 各模型成功新调用次数、历史实际扣额总量和平均扣额是多少？包含暂无调用的模型。
questions.finding: 支持：calls 的成功记录粒度、历史 charged_units 和模型关联足以定义计数／求和／算术平均；零调用的平均值为 NULL。
questions.sql:
SELECT m.id AS model_id, m.name AS model_name,
       COUNT(c.id) AS successful_new_calls,
       COALESCE(SUM(c.charged_units), 0) AS historical_charged_units,
       AVG(c.charged_units) AS average_charged_units
FROM models AS m
LEFT JOIN calls AS c ON c.model_id = m.id
GROUP BY m.id, m.name
ORDER BY m.id;

questions.question: 每个凭证授权了多少个模型、成功调用多少次、实际扣额多少、当前余额多少？包含零调用凭证。
questions.finding: 支持：分别按 key_id 预聚合 model_grants 与 calls，再与 api_keys 左连接，避免两条一对多关系相乘。remaining_quota 只显示余额，不当作可调用次数。
questions.sql:
WITH grant_totals AS (
    SELECT key_id, COUNT(*) AS authorized_models
    FROM model_grants
    GROUP BY key_id
), call_totals AS (
    SELECT key_id, COUNT(*) AS successful_new_calls,
           SUM(charged_units) AS historical_charged_units
    FROM calls
    GROUP BY key_id
)
SELECT k.id AS key_id, k.name AS key_name,
       COALESCE(g.authorized_models, 0) AS authorized_models,
       COALESCE(c.successful_new_calls, 0) AS successful_new_calls,
       COALESCE(c.historical_charged_units, 0) AS historical_charged_units,
       k.remaining_quota
FROM api_keys AS k
LEFT JOIN grant_totals AS g ON g.key_id = k.id
LEFT JOIN call_totals AS c ON c.key_id = k.id
ORDER BY k.id;

questions.question: 按凭证状态、授权、模型状态和额度条件，哪些凭证—模型组合满足一次新调用的准入条件？
questions.finding: 条件支持：模型给出了完整准入业务条件、列与连接；models.enabled 明确 1=启用，但 api_keys.enabled 未声明启用编码，保留 key_enabled_value 参数，不能从另一列复制编码。
questions.sql:
SELECT k.id AS key_id, k.name AS key_name,
       m.id AS model_id, m.name AS model_name,
       k.remaining_quota, m.quota_cost,
       k.remaining_quota - m.quota_cost AS quota_after_one_new_call
FROM api_keys AS k
JOIN model_grants AS g ON g.key_id = k.id
JOIN models AS m ON m.id = g.model_id
WHERE k.enabled = :key_enabled_value
  AND m.enabled = 1
  AND k.remaining_quota >= m.quota_cost
ORDER BY k.id, m.id;

questions.question: 哪些启用凭证还有正余额，却不足以调用其已授权且启用的模型？
questions.finding: 条件支持：当前 cost 与正余额不足判据明确；同 Q3，凭证启用编码需额外确认。
questions.sql:
SELECT k.id AS key_id, k.name AS key_name,
       m.id AS model_id, m.name AS model_name,
       k.remaining_quota, m.quota_cost,
       m.quota_cost - k.remaining_quota AS missing_units
FROM api_keys AS k
JOIN model_grants AS g ON g.key_id = k.id
JOIN models AS m ON m.id = g.model_id
WHERE k.enabled = :key_enabled_value
  AND m.enabled = 1
  AND k.remaining_quota > 0
  AND k.remaining_quota < m.quota_cost
ORDER BY k.id, m.id;

questions.question: 哪些模型存在历史实际扣额与当前扣额配置不同的成功调用？有多少次、实际扣额合计多少？
questions.finding: 支持：比较历史 calls.charged_units 与 models.quota_cost，不按当前费用重算历史；差异不等于可推算调价事件时间。
questions.sql:
SELECT m.id AS model_id, m.name AS model_name,
       m.quota_cost AS current_quota_cost,
       COUNT(c.id) AS calls_with_different_historical_charge,
       SUM(c.charged_units) AS historical_charged_units
FROM models AS m
JOIN calls AS c ON c.model_id = m.id
WHERE c.charged_units <> m.quota_cost
GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.quota_cost
ORDER BY m.id;

questions.question: 哪些请求标识曾被两个或更多不同凭证成功使用？
questions.finding: 支持：请求标识只在单凭证内去重，按 request_id 分组并 count(distinct key_id)，不把 request_id 当全局主键。
questions.sql:
SELECT request_id, COUNT(DISTINCT key_id) AS credential_count,
       COUNT(*) AS successful_records
FROM calls
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT key_id) >= 2
ORDER BY request_id;

questions.question: 2026-10-31 UTC 当天各模型成功新调用次数与实际扣额总量是多少？
questions.finding: 条件支持：有 created_at 字段和成功记录粒度，但模型明确时区／格式未知，不能确定 UTC 日边界与转换；不输出可执行 SQL。

questions.question: 各模型今天被拒绝和历史回放的次数分别是多少？
questions.finding: 不支持：模型只映射成功记录，拒绝不产生成功行，回放返回旧记录；没有可统计拒绝／回放事件次数的映射，不能以缺行推断事件次数为零。

questions.question: 各模型最近一次调整扣额单位的时间、调整前后数值和操作人是什么？
questions.finding: 不支持：只有当前 quota_cost 和调用时实际扣额，没有调价事件的时间／前后值／操作人映射；不能用调用时间代替调价时间。

additional_findings: api_keys.remaining_quota retains the older source_unit 次（调用次数） although CallRecord and Model describe variable debit units. Use the explicit per-new-call cost rule; do not interpret balance as remaining invocation count.

source_key is separately models/api_keys/model_grants/calls, schema_version is null, and schema_source still names @2112c3e although quota_cost was added later. This audit uses an explicit approved single-SQLite binding; automatic source/version resolution is not demonstrated.

Some prose unknowns say cardinality is undeclared while JoinMapping.step_semantics gives one_to_many/many_to_one. This inconsistency should be reviewed; this SQL uses mapped keys, exact join pairs and preaggregation rather than inventing business multiplicities.
